def slugify(s):
    s = short_subject(s).strip().lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9._+-]+", "-", s).strip("-")
    return s or "patch"

def unique_name(m, base):
    if base not in m["patches"]: return base
    i = 2
    while f"{base}-{i}" in m["patches"]: i += 1
    return f"{base}-{i}"

def invalid_patch_reason(name):
    if '/' in name: return "patch name may not contain '/'"
    if re.search(r"\s", name): return "patch name may not contain whitespace"
    if name.startswith('.'): return "patch name may not start with '.'"
    if name.endswith('.lock'): return "patch name may not end with '.lock'"
    if '..' in name: return "patch name may not contain '..'"
    for ch in ['~','^',':','?','*','[','\\']:
        if ch in name: return f"patch name may not contain '{ch}'"
    if name in ('', '@'): return "invalid patch name"
    return None

def validate_patch_name(name, arglabel="[patchname]"):
    r = invalid_patch_reason(name)
    if r:
        eprint(f"error: invalid value '{name}' for '{arglabel}': invalid patch name `{name}`: {r}\n")
        eprint("For more information, try '--help'.")
        sys.exit(1)

def parse_message(args):
    msg = None; author = None; authdate = None; signoff = False; rest=[]; i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ('-m','--message') and i+1 < len(args): msg=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--message='): msg=a.split('=',1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a in ('-f','--file') and i+1 < len(args): msg=Path(args[i+1]).read_text(); i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--file='): msg=Path(a.split('=',1)[1]).read_text(); i+=1
        elif a == '--author' and i+1 < len(args): author=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--author='): author=a.split('=',1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a == '--authdate' and i+1 < len(args): authdate=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a in ('-s','--signoff') or a.startswith('--signoff'):
            signoff=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-e','--edit','-d','--diff','--no-verify','--committer-date-is-author-date'):
            i+=1
        elif a in ('--ack','--review') and i+1 < len(args): i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--ack') or a.startswith('--review'): i+=1
        elif a in ('--authname','--authemail','--save-template') and i+1 < len(args): i+=2
        else: rest.append(a); i+=1
    if msg is None: msg = ""
    if signoff:
        who = git_out(["var", "GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT"], check=False)
        m = re.match(r"(.*>).*", who)
        trailer = "Signed-off-by: " + (m.group(1) if m else who)
        msg = msg.rstrip()+"\n\n"+trailer+"\n"
    return msg, author, authdate, rest

def commit_env(author=None, authdate=None):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    if author:
        m = re.match(r"(.*?)\s*<([^>]+)>", author)
        if m:
            env["GIT_AUTHOR_NAME"] = m.group(1).strip(); env["GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"] = m.group(2).strip()
        else:
            env["GIT_AUTHOR_NAME"] = author
    if authdate: env["GIT_AUTHOR_DATE"] = authdate
    return env

def commit_allow_empty(msg, author=None, authdate=None, amend=False, reuse=None):
    args=["commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "--allow-empty-message"]
    if amend: args.append("--amend")
    if reuse: args += ["-C", reuse]
    else: args += ["-m", msg]
    git(args, env=commit_env(author, authdate))
    return git_out(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])

def diff_nonempty(a,b):
    return git(["diff", "--quiet", a, b], check=False).returncode == 1

def parent_of(commit):
    p = git(["rev-parse", f"{commit}^"], check=False, capture=True)
    return p.stdout.strip() if p.returncode == 0 else ""

def commit_subject(commit):
    return git_out(["log", "-1", "--format=%s", commit], check=False)

def commit_body(commit):
    return git_out(["log", "-1", "--format=%B", commit], check=False).rstrip('\n')

def is_empty_commit(commit):
    par = parent_of(commit)
    if not par: return False
    return git(["diff", "--quiet", par, commit], check=False).returncode == 0

def resolve_revision(m, rev):
    if rev is None or rev in ('@', 'HEAD'):
        if m and m.get("applied"): return m["patches"][m["applied"][-1]]["commit"]
        return git_out(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    # Split patch names followed by normal git suffixes, e.g. p~1.
    mo = re.match(r"([^~^:]+)(.*)$", rev)
    if m and mo and mo.group(1) in m["patches"]:
        base = m["patches"][mo.group(1)]["commit"]
        return git_out(["rev-parse", base+mo.group(2)])
    if m and rev in m["patches"]: return m["patches"][rev]["commit"]
    p = git(["rev-parse", rev], check=False, capture=True)
    if p.returncode == 0: return p.stdout.strip()
    if m:
        raise StgError(f"patch `{rev}` does not exist", 2)
    raise StgError(f"unknown revision `{rev}`", 2)

def name_for_commit(m, commit, showbranch=False):
    full = git_out(["rev-parse", commit])
    for n, info in m.get("patches", {}).items():
        if git_out(["rev-parse", info["commit"]], check=False) == full:
            return f"{m['branch']}:{n}" if showbranch else n
    base = m.get("base")
    if base and git_out(["rev-parse", base], check=False) == full:
        return "{base}"
    raise StgError(f"commit {full} does not correspond to a patch", 2)

def reset_to_current_top(m):
    target = m["patches"][m["applied"][-1]]["commit"] if m["applied"] else m["base"]
    if target:
        git(["reset", "--hard", "-q", target])

def remove_from_lists(m, name):
    for lst in ("applied", "unapplied", "hidden"):
        if name in m[lst]: m[lst].remove(name)

def cmd_init(args):
    branch = None; i=0
    while i<len(args):
        if args[i] in ('-b','--branch') and i+1<len(args): branch=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif args[i].startswith('--branch='): branch=args[i].split('=',1)[1]; i+=1
        elif args[i].startswith('--color'): i += 2 if args[i]=='--color' and i+1<len(args) else 1
        else: i+=1
    br, _ = ensure_head() if branch is None else (branch, f"refs/heads/{branch}")
    # Verify selected branch is born.
    if branch is not None:
        p=git(["rev-parse", "--verify", f"refs/heads/{branch}"], check=False, capture=True)
        if p.returncode!=0: raise StgError(f"branch `refs/heads/{branch}` is unborn", 2)
    if meta_path(br).exists():
        raise StgError(f"StGit stack already initialized for branch `{br}`", 2)
    m=default_meta(br); save_meta(m); return 0

def cmd_new(args):
    msg, author, authdate, args = parse_message(args)
    name=None; refresh=False; use_index=False; force=False; paths=[]; i=0; after_dd=False
    while i<len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if after_dd: paths.append(a); i+=1
        elif a=='--': after_dd=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-n','--name') and i+1<len(args): name=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--name='): name=a.split('=',1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a in ('-r','--refresh'): refresh=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-i','--index'): use_index=True; refresh=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-F','--force'): force=True; refresh=True; i+=1
        elif a.startswith('-') or a in ('--submodules','--no-submodules'): i+=1
        elif name is None: name=a; i+=1
        else: paths.append(a); i+=1
    br,_=ensure_head(); m=load_meta(br, create=True)
    if name is None: name=unique_name(m, slugify(msg))
    validate_patch_name(name)
    if name in m["patches"]: raise StgError(f"patch `{name}` already exists", 2)
    if refresh and not use_index:
        if force: git(["add", "-A", "--"] + paths if paths else ["add", "-A"])
        else: git(["add", "-u", "--"] + paths if paths else ["add", "-u"])
    elif refresh and use_index:
        pass
    commit=commit_allow_empty(msg, author, authdate)
    m["applied"].append(name)
    m["patches"][name]={"commit":commit,"message":msg,"author":author or "","authdate":authdate or ""}
    save_meta(m)
    print(f"> {name} (new)")
    return 0

def cmd_refresh(args):
    msg, author, authdate, args = parse_message(args)
    use_index=False; force=False; patch=None; paths=[]; i=0
    while i<len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ('-i','--index'): use_index=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-F','--force'): force=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-p','--patch') and i+1<len(args): patch=args[i+1]; i+=2
        elif a.startswith('--patch='): patch=a.split('=',1)[1]; i+=1
        elif a in ('-u','--update','--submodules','--no-submodules') or a.startswith('--conflicts'):
            i+=1
        elif a in ('-a','--annotate') and i+1<len(args): i+=2
        elif a.startswith('-'): i+=1
        else: paths.append(a); i+=1
    br,_=ensure_head(); m=load_meta(br, create=False)
    if not m or not m["applied"]: raise StgError("no patches applied", 2)
    name=patch or m["applied"][-1]
    if name not in m["applied"]: patch_info(m,name)  # validates
    if name != m["applied"][-1]:
        # Metadata-only edit for non-top; real StGit rewrites descendants. Keep common output.
        if msg: m["patches"][name]["message"]=msg
        save_meta(m); print(f"& {name}"); print(f"> {m['applied'][-1]}"); return 0
    old_commit=m["patches"][name]["commit"]
    if not use_index:
        git(["add", "-A", "--"]+paths if force and paths else (["add","-A"] if force else (["add","-u","--"]+paths if paths else ["add","-u"])))
    newmsg = msg if msg != "" else m["patches"][name].get("message", commit_body(old_commit))
    commit=commit_allow_empty(newmsg, author or m["patches"][name].get("author") or None, authdate or None, amend=True)
    m["patches"][name]["commit"]=commit; m["patches"][name]["message"]=newmsg
    if author: m["patches"][name]["author"]=author
    save_meta(m)
    print("> refresh-temp (new)"); print("- refresh-temp"); print("# refresh-temp")
    par=parent_of(commit)
    if par and diff_nonempty(par, commit): print(f"& {name}")
    print(f"> {name}")
    return 0

            v=a.split('=',1)[1]; commit_id=int(v) if v else 40; i+=1

def status_prefix(m, name, opts):
    if opts.get("no_prefix"): return ""
    if name in m["hidden"]: core="!"
    elif name in m["unapplied"]: core="-"
    elif m["applied"] and name == m["applied"][-1]: core=">"
    else: core="+"
    star="*" if opts.get("empty") and is_empty_commit(m["patches"][name]["commit"]) else " "
    return star+core+" "

    br,_=ensure_head(); m=load_meta(br, create=False)
    if not m: return 0
    order, opts = select_series(m,args)
    if opts["count"]:
        print(len(order)); return 0
    rows=[]
    for n in order:
        parts=[]; pref=status_prefix(m,n,opts)
        cid=""
        if opts["commit_id"]:
            cid=m["patches"][n]["commit"][:opts["commit_id"]]+" "
        display=(m['branch']+":"+n) if opts["showbranch"] else n
        line=pref+cid+display

def pop_names(m, names, allflag=False, number=None):
    if not m["applied"]: raise StgError("no patches applied",2)
    if allflag: return list(m["applied"])
    if number is not None: return m["applied"][-number:]
    if names:
        for n in names:
            if n not in m["applied"]: patch_info(m,n)
        first=min(m["applied"].index(n) for n in names)
        return m["applied"][first:]
    return [m["applied"][-1]]

def cmd_pop(args):
    allflag=False; num=None; names=[]; spill=False; i=0
    while i<len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ('-a','--all'): allflag=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-n','--number') and i+1<len(args): num=int(args[i+1]); i+=2
        elif a in ('-s','--spill'): spill=True; i+=1
        elif a.startswith('-'): i+=1
        else: names.append(a); i+=1
    m=load_meta(create=False)
    if not m: raise StgError("no patches applied",2)
    pops=pop_names(m,names,allflag,num)
    if not pops: return 0
    for n in pops: m["applied"].remove(n)
    m["unapplied"] = pops + [n for n in m["unapplied"] if n not in pops]
    if spill:
        git(["reset", "--mixed", m["patches"][m["applied"][-1]]["commit"] if m["applied"] else m["base"]])
    else: reset_to_current_top(m)
    save_meta(m)
    print(f"- {pops[0]}" + (f"..{pops[-1]}" if len(pops)>1 else ""))
    if m["applied"]: print(f"> {m['applied'][-1]}")
    return 0

def cherry_pick_patch(m, n):
    old=m["patches"][n]["commit"]
    p=git(["cherry-pick", "--allow-empty", "--keep-redundant-commits", "-q", old], check=False, capture=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        # Keep partial state similar enough: conflict is an operation error.
        sys.stderr.write("error: merge conflicts; resolve conflicts manually then refresh or undo the operation with `stg undo --hard`.\n")
        return False
    new=git_out(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    m["patches"][n]["commit"]=new
    return True

def cmd_push(args):
    allflag=False; num=None; names=[]; noapply=False; reverse=False; i=0
    while i<len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ('-a','--all'): allflag=True; i+=1
        elif a in ('-n','--number') and i+1<len(args): num=int(args[i+1]); i+=2
        elif a=='--noapply': noapply=True; i+=1
        elif a=='--reverse': reverse=True; i+=1
        elif a.startswith('-'): i+=1
        else: names.append(a); i+=1
    m=load_meta(create=False)
    if not m: raise StgError("no unapplied patches",2)
    if names:
        for n in names:
            if n not in m["unapplied"]: patch_info(m,n)
        pushes=names
    elif allflag: pushes=list(m["unapplied"])
    elif num is not None: pushes=m["unapplied"][:num]
    else:
        if not m["unapplied"]: raise StgError("no unapplied patches",2)
        pushes=[m["unapplied"][0]]
    if reverse: pushes=list(reversed(pushes))
    for idx,n in enumerate(pushes):
        if n in m["unapplied"]: m["unapplied"].remove(n)
        if not noapply:
            ok=cherry_pick_patch(m,n)
            if not ok:
                m["applied"].append(n); save_meta(m); return 3
        m["applied"].append(n)
        print(("> " if idx==len(pushes)-1 else "+ ")+n)
    save_meta(m); return 0

def cmd_goto(args):
    target=None
    for a in args:
        if not a.startswith('-'): target=a
    if not target: raise StgError("the following required arguments were not provided: <patch>",1)
    m=load_meta(create=False); patch_info(m,target)
    if target in m["applied"]:
        idx=m["applied"].index(target); pops=m["applied"][idx+1:]
        if pops:
            for n in pops: m["applied"].remove(n)
            m["unapplied"]=pops+[n for n in m["unapplied"] if n not in pops]
            reset_to_current_top(m); save_meta(m)
            print(f"- {pops[0]}"+(f"..{pops[-1]}" if len(pops)>1 else ""))
        print(f"> {target}")
        return 0
    if target in m["unapplied"]:
        idx=m["unapplied"].index(target); names=m["unapplied"][:idx+1]
        # inline push to preserve output
        for i,n in enumerate(names):
            m["unapplied"].remove(n); cherry_pick_patch(m,n); m["applied"].append(n)
            print(("> " if i==len(names)-1 else "+ ")+n)
        save_meta(m); return 0
    raise StgError(f"patch `{target}` is hidden",2)

def resolve_revision(m, rev):
    if rev is None or rev in ('@', 'HEAD'):
        if m and m.get("applied"): return m["patches"][m["applied"][-1]]["commit"]
        return git_out(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
    # Split patch names followed by normal git suffixes, e.g. p~1.
    mo = re.match(r"([^~^:]+)(.*)$", rev)
    if m and mo and mo.group(1) in m["patches"]:
        base = m["patches"][mo.group(1)]["commit"]
        return git_out(["rev-parse", base+mo.group(2)])
    if m and rev in m["patches"]: return m["patches"][rev]["commit"]
    p = git(["rev-parse", rev], check=False, capture=True)
    if p.returncode == 0: return p.stdout.strip()

        raise StgError(f"patch `{rev}` does not exist", 2)
    raise StgError(f"unknown revision `{rev}`", 2)

def name_for_commit(m, commit, showbranch=False):
    full = git_out(["rev-parse", commit])
    for n, info in m.get("patches", {}).items():
        if git_out(["rev-parse", info["commit"]], check=False) == full:
            return f"{m['branch']}:{n}" if showbranch else n
    base = m.get("base")
    if base and git_out(["rev-parse", base], check=False) == full:
        return "{base}"
    raise StgError(f"commit {full} does not correspond to a patch", 2)

        c=m["patches"][n]["commit"]; par=parent_of(c)
        msg=m["patches"][n].get("message", commit_body(c))
        author=git_out(["log","-1","--format=%an <%ae>",c], check=False)

    ser=[f"# This series applies on Git commit {m.get('base','')}" ]
